acip: MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD RTAG PA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD RTAG PA YIN, KHYOD RTAG PA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING RTAG PA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB BA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, rtag pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa chos can, khyod rtag pa'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod rtag pa yin, khyod rtag pa dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing rtag pa yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub ba'i phyir
english: I disagree with your reason here: it is not the case that that which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor characteristic of them is characteristic of unchanging things. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then that which is neither a quality of unchanging things, nor characteristic of them. It is so characteristic of unchanging things, Because (1) it is unchanging; (2) it is related to unchanging things in such a way that to be it is to be an unchanging thing; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not it, but which are still unchanging things.
